temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days, which is uncharacteristic during a busy week at the bank. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging; her recent quietness is unusual and concerning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Marilyn reveals that she is overwhelmed by work and personal issues rather than simply being distant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is under significant work and personal stress, and she acknowledges Carolyn's concern.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and sympathetic, with some relief that Marilyn responded.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Marilyn and leave the door open for her to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn was curt in a subsequent interaction. When Carolyn apologizes for possibly overstepping and shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is under significant work and personal stress and acknowledged Carolyn's concern, but her recent curtness leaves Carolyn confused and wondering if she overstepped or if Marilyn is upset with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Marilyn's apology and explanation show that her curtness was due to a hard week, not necessarily to Carolyn overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn appreciated Carolyn's openness; her curtness was not about Carolyn's overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and slightly hurt, then relieved and reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear up any misunderstanding, show support, and continue supportive contact.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appeared to respond positively to Carolyn's openness. When Carolyn invites her to a small gathering, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks Carolyn, and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn appreciated Carolyn's openness, and Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful about their budding friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Marilyn accepts the invitation with enthusiasm.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in socializing and building a friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the friendship and host the gathering.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Marilyn still maintains a professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is interested in friendship outside work, but at work she remains professionally distant; Carolyn is disappointed and unsure why.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Marilyn did not realize the distance and is open to improving their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The work distance may be unintended, and Marilyn is willing to discuss and improve their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then cautiously reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To address the work dynamic and improve collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. When Carolyn proposes teaming up on the new project, Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they talked, and looks forward to working closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: They have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; Carolyn feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Marilyn enthusiastically accepts the collaborative project and confirms she wants to work closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is strengthened, and Marilyn wants to collaborate more closely.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up on the new project and further their partnership.
